plan.title: Psoriasis lesional vs control DE from TPM (limma-trend)
plan.analytical_narrative:
The input is a 12,000-gene x 12-sample gene-level TPM table from Salmon (tpm.csv, first column gene symbol) with a 12x2 metadata table giving one condition per sample: 6 psoriasis lesional vs 6 control skin, unpaired, single batch. No raw counts and no Salmon quantification directories were delivered, so the count-model route (DESeq2 / edgeR / voom) is unavailable: those assume integer counts with negative-binomial variance and TPM breaks that assumption. The plan therefore follows the abundance route end to end — log2(TPM+1), an abundance floor of 1 TPM in at least 6 samples (the smallest group size), and a limma linear model with trend=TRUE and robust=TRUE empirical Bayes moderation, BH adjustment across the tested genes.

T1S1 does sample-structure QC first, on log2(TPM+1): PCA/MDS on the 500 most variable genes, a sample-distance heatmap, and detected-gene counts per sample, coloured by condition. With n=6 per group a single mis-grouped sample materially changes the result, so any sample that does not sit with its condition is flagged and carried forward as a caveat rather than silently dropped. T1S2 fits the model and produces the ranked gene table: control is set as the explicit reference level so a positive log2FC means higher in lesional, and the fold-change question is handled inside the test with treat() rather than by a post-hoc filter on the estimate. T1S3 writes the report with the full reproducibility record.

The research question asks only which genes differ, so no enrichment, deconvolution or signature step is planned — that would be unasked scope. The honest limitations, which the report must state: TPM has already absorbed a within-sample length and depth scaling, so no between-sample count normalization is applied and cross-protocol comparability cannot be assumed; the lengthScaledTPM/tximport route that would have been preferred is impossible without the quantification directories; and 6 vs 6 is modest power, so absence of significance is not evidence of no change.
